responsibility: This header exposes shared LTO/plugin constants, specifically the textual mapping for linker resolution codes. It serves as the lightweight interface for code that needs to interpret or print LTO symbol resolution states without depending on the full LTO front-end implementation.
same_name_distinction: This is the lightweight header side of the common pair: it exposes only the resolution-name mapping as header data for users, whereas gcc/lto/common.cc is the compiled implementation file that defines the full shared string tables, including symbol-kind and visibility names.
